name: Free model via OpenRouter
note: Needs OPENROUTER_API_KEY. The default model is a free-tier one (rate-limited, costs nothing). Set "model" to any id from https://openrouter.ai/models, e.g. openai/gpt-6-astra or google/gemini-3.8-flash.

name: Gemini
note: Needs GEMINI_API_KEY (or GOOGLE_API_KEY). Default model gemini-3.8-flash. Google's own free tier applies.

name: Greedy bot
note: A scripted bot. Other kinds: random, openai, groq, deepseek, xai, mistral, together, ollama, lmstudio, vllm, http. Human seats only exist in Unity.
